findings.body: When a formula has a cached Excel error result such as `{ error: "#N/A" }`, `hasUncachedFormula` permits it and `formulaResult` returns the error object. This fallback then converts it to `"[object Object]"`. Text fields such as Plant, Cost Center, GL code, or transaction identity can consequently be accepted with a fabricated value, and `sourceRow` loses the original error evidence. Error-valued formula results should be rejected or represented faithfully before string coercion.
findings.title: Reject cached formula errors before coercing them to text
